title: A hostile toll-camp (Sack Road Camp, Free Companies-aligned) and a hostile bandit camp (the Wreckers' Roost) share the same room names, the same free Scout 'mark the sentries' rounds' action, and the same slip-past mechanic, which makes them read as the same kind of encounter until the room flavor text clarifies one is meant to be paid/slipped and the other fought.
